    Atomic invariants — fourfolds¶

    Atomic invariants · Geometric catalogue · Exact data

    The factor numbers below refer to the characteristic polynomial of A=c1⋆ A = c 1 ⋆ at the stated point. Each row applies separately at every root of its indicated factor. Long exact polynomials and determinants are retained in the downloadable data.

    Hypersurface in a toric fivefold (CKP-172)¶

    Construction, inputs and matrix

    Dimension: 4. Ambient rank: 12. Full cohomology rank: 32. Full Hodge-invariant rank: 12.

    Full Hodge polynomial: PX(t)=t2+30+t−2 P X ( t ) = t 2 + 30 + t − 2 .

    Analysis point: y1=2, y2=3, y3=5. Unit determinant: zero at every tested point.

    No atomic decomposition is certified at these points; cyclicity may hold at other quantum parameters.
